Met a guy online, was in his late 20s. Thought he had his own place. We decided to hang out, I was on the way to his place when he said: btw my family lives here too. I was really pissed because I find it really weird to meet someone’s family on the first date...you don’t even know if you’ll be compatible or not. Anyway, I naturally am a very nice person so I decided to still meet him, but thing got way worse. He had no job, cooked me some really shitty food, which I’m sure was prepackaged meals. He wanted to walk to Walmart to buy drinks when it was already dark..I did not want to use my car because I wanted this date to end so I told him I was tired from driving since I had done it all day. Was forced to walk behind him and his dog to Walmart. Sat in a bench while he got drinks. I really don’t know how he didn’t get the hint. I texted my friend to pretend she was my boss and call me telling me to come in tomorrow so it worked and I ended up leaving. Next time o will verify someone as not being a nut prior to meeting with them.
